title: The merge gate: green, a yes, no hold
subtitle: One rule, read live from GitHub, on the exact PR head

messages.label: webhook: checks completed on head H
re-read the live check rollup for H
green: dispatch review of head H
gate: green AND yes on H AND no hold
brief allows merge? claim head H
squash merge at H (or merge queue)

messages.text: A new commit cancels the yes; a brief edit does not. A hold is the only veto, and yolo is not a merge condition
